highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Murray State University (MSU) is a public university located in Murray, Kentucky. The university offers you over 140 undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across fields like Business, Engineering, Nursing, Education, Agriculture, and the Arts.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At MSU, with around 9,000 students, you get a personalised student experience. MSU offers you high-quality education with small class sizes and a close-knit community atmosphere. You can choose from more than 170 student organisations, including leadership clubs, multicultural groups, recreational sports, and more.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
MSU provides a range of on-campus housing options, including traditional dorms, residential colleges, and apartment-style options. The university can help you find safe and comfortable housing nearby in the Murray area.

You can also download our app and check out the Stays feature for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
On campus, the Waterfield Library and Pogue Library offer you everything from textbooks and databases to collaborative spaces for research.

Sports
Whether you want to join a team or just work out, you can stay active with gyms, fitness classes, intramurals, and varsity sports. Plus, MSU is home to the Murray State Racers, competing in NCAA Division I.

Laboratory
You’ll find state-of-the-art STEM labs and agriculture facilities. Their School of Nursing and Engineering Technology are especially well-equipped.

Cafeteria
Whether you want vegan food or coffee, you can get it from MSU’s Winslow Dining Hall, plus multiple cafés and food spots across campus.
